strings.name: Justin Bieber
strings.summary: Discovered through online singing videos, Bieber entered global mainstream music with My World and My World 2.0, then expanded into dance and R&B through Purpose. His career links teenage internet fame and the global industry, alongside legal incidents and health interruptions. The SWAG releases followed in 2025, with a major festival headline return in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Through My World, Purpose and global performances, he connects online fame with mainstream music and influences a new generation of pop culture.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: London, Ontario, Canada; raised in Stratford.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Received a St. Michael Catholic Secondary School diploma in 2012.
